**The evidence does not establish whether the 2025 loss was caused by clearing for agriculture.**

The data indicate a candidate tree-cover loss of about 13.5 hectares, or 3.9% of the property. Most of the affected area was mapped as native forest in 2021. However, tree-cover loss can have several causes, and the available evidence does not identify the cause or establish a change to agricultural land use.

The loss also remains pending corroboration because no later year has yet been observed.
